original_card.question: Can one measured replay bottleneck be sped up without dropping coverage?
methods: Profile one isolated replay and optimize the measured bottleneck.
Design source-bound reuse with explicit dependency invalidation and negative controls.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Report before/after wall time on the same fixture, retained checks and invalidation behavior.

first_step.inspect: Read the selected reproduction command and choose a single replay stage for profiling.
first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Measure one unchanged fixture, preserve check coverage, and test one optimization with invalidation controls.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Faster trustworthy replays increase review throughput and let mechanism candidates be checked sooner.
allowed_variations: Profile one stage or design one source-bound cache boundary.
scope_change_triggers: Skipping coverage or comparing different fixtures to claim speedup.

actual_scope: Can the production sparse-fusion central_gate_screen (scripts/audit_sparse_fusion.py, exercised by make verify / certificates/sparse-fusion-audit.json) adopt the exact spectator-orbit weighted representatives from research/sparse-fusion-orbits/ so the shipped verify path is faster while every screen field, joint-pair inequality and complete certificate stays identical?
scope_change_reason: The catalogue card asks for one measured replay bottleneck with before/after wall time and retained checks. Expertise override selected verifier-engineering after profiling make verify poles. Leave-alone objects (joint frames, shared-point, mixed-point verify, ternary frames, parity-side, DisjointTensor.frame_data, production verify_factor, leech_minor production, quadratic-affine) and deferred micro-opts were not reopened. ToikY's incorporated sparse-fusion-orbits adapter already proved an opt-in identical-receipt accelerator; production still enumerated all C(h,3) triples pairwise.
bottleneck_link: Side result on review throughput: sparse-fusion is part of make verify. Faster identical central_gate_screen ranks do not change kappa or the binding complex supplier.
ai_assistance: Substantial AI assistance for orientation, overlap search, profiling, production wiring, packaging, benchmarking and writing
evidence: PASS_SPARSE_FUSION_ORBITS_PRODUCTION via research/sparse-fusion-orbits-production/verify.py (also under -O); PASS_IDENTICAL_SPARSE_FUSION_ORBITS_PRODUCTION_RECEIPTS via benchmark.py; certificates/sparse-fusion-audit.json remains byte-identical to the base commit.
author: Wentao Li
stop_rule: Ship an equivalence-preserving production central_gate_screen change with frozen baseline, identical screen and complete-certificate payloads, rejection/temp-corruption controls, unchanged certificate bytes, registered replay and a measured before/after median. Do not invent kappa or reopen leave-alone objects.
